results.description: In a significant diplomatic and economic maneuver, US President Donald Trump has issued a 60-day national interest waiver on sweeping sanctions and tariffs under the newly enacted Lindsey O. results.title: Assam: Seven fishermen allegedly assaulted by group at Kurihamari Char
results.description: A sensational incident has been reported from Garighat in Kurihamari Char under the Barkhetri constituency, where seven fishermen were allegedly assaulted by a group of people while fishing in the Brahmaputra river on Friday afternoon.
